text:
maria: Ok team — starting a doc thread for the long-term 'routing runway' initiative. Goal: define guardrails, launch criteria, and prioritization matrix for multi-region + tenant isolation. Need input from eng, infra, product, security. Quick ask: what are top 3 risks that would block customer pilots? Also propose metrics we need to gate on. TL;DR: want a 6–9 month roadmap with clear phases and launch gates.

aj: From runtime POV: top risks = 1) capacity fragmentation (hot shards) 2) KV/cache consistency across regions 3) tail latency under batching/traffic spikes. Must have perf harness + canary load tests before any pilot. Benchmarks: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec per GPU, cache hit %.

sophie: For model-aware routing we should define a small policy DSL to express region, model_variant, latency_budget, cost_tier. Example snippet: ```policy {
  match: region == 'eu' && model in ['redwood-small']
  route: eu-quantized-pool
  fallback: global-standard
}``` This will let the console show candidate routes and expected cost delta.

kevin: Architecture proposal (phased):
- Phase 1: soft-affinity (region-preference, sticky routing, no physical isolation)
- Phase 2: logical slices (quota + telemetry isolation, limited dedicated capacity)
- Phase 3: physical isolation (dedicated pools, tenancy boundaries)
Each phase needs gating criteria (perf, cost-estimates, canary success, compliance checklist).

liam: Compliance flags: data residency proof, KMS/HSM integration, audit log retention and export. Blocker example: EU regulated customer requires KMS + no egress -> must be green before Phase 2 for those customers. Add `kms_ok` and `audit_retention_days` to gating matrix.

cs_jen: From pilot feedback (3 customers): predictable p95 latency <200ms is a hard ask, regional residency, and explicit rollback windows for traffic shifts. They're willing to accept fallback to a lower-capacity model if latency degrades, but want transparent SLA mapping.

deploy-bot: canary: routing-runway:v1 -> started (50 users), errors: 0, avg p95: 180ms, tags added: `route.policy`, `model.variant`.

maria: Action items / owners:
1) aj + sophie: perf harness + initial DSL proposal (include schema + small simulator) — due Mon 3/7.
2) kevin + liam: gating checklist & compliance matrix (include cost delta estimates per phase) — due Wed 3/9.
3) cs_jen: collect top 5 SLA asks from pilots + sample rollout windows — due Fri 3/11.
I'll open a GH issue and link specs. We'll treat Dedicated as the commercial milestone that maps to Phase 3.

aj: Metrics we should surface asap on the console: `token/sec_per_gpu`, `avg_tokens_per_request`, `cache_hit_rate`, `model_switch_latency`, `failover_time`, `p99_latency`. I'll scaffold dashboards and alerts (p99 > target -> auto-fallback).

sophie: Also want automated evals tied to canaries — Redwood Optimize can run prompt sets and flag quality regressions. Add a quality gate to the checklist (no more than X% drop on core prompts).

kevin: Tradeoff note: stronger isolation multiplies infra cost (rough estimate 2–3x for Phase 3). We'll include explicit cost deltas so PMs and Sales can set expectations.

maria: :thumbsup: Scheduling a sync Thu 10:00am to align on timeline and risks. If anyone has objections to phase definitions or gating items, raise them here before Wed EOD.

cs_jen: Works for customers — I'll loop in pilot leads and include sample acceptance criteria from them.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post the GH issue + initial template for gating matrix after this sync.
